newsitem.title: MEXICO: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.

text.p: USDA said on Friday that steer calves and yearlings exported to the United States from Mexico sold mostly steady.
Exports for the week were estimated at 8,000 head into Texas and New Mexico states. Confirmed exports for the previous week totaled 7,934 head, against 1,982 head in the same week in 1996.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Around 60 percent of supply were retained by owners, or sold prevously on video," USDA said.
Prices for feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were 94-104 cents/lb, for 400-500 lb they were 84-94 cents/lb and 500-600 lb they were 80-84 cents/lb
Imports into Mexico were estimated to have totaled 2,500 head for the week, it added.
